C0535.title: Man Repeatedly Requests Refund-Only for Online Purchases, Maliciously Places Over 2,700 Orders Against 900+ Merchants
C0535.summary: A man maliciously placed over 2,700 orders against more than 900 e-commerce merchants by requesting refund-only after batch ordering, involving transaction flows exceeding 10 million yuan, and was ultimately sentenced to one year and six months in prison.

references.title: Man repeatedly applies for refund-only on online purchases, maliciously orders from over 900 merchants, over 2,700 times
